policy.writeModel: parallel read-only subagents, serialized main-integrator writes
policy.adjustmentRule: At 15-minute cadence, loops must ship one coherent visible improvement or report a real blocker. No placeholder progress posts.

runs.label: operator workstation believability pass
facility scale and hangar depth pass
runs.notes: Expanded scene footprint/room separation and added distant hangar service depth.

runs.label: fixed facility navigation and asteroid rim pass
runs.notes: Pivoted from orbit showcase to fixed front-facing WASD/click facility traversal with wider room separation and asteroid rim framing.

runs.label: embedded remote bay visual scale pass
runs.notes: Converted room pads into larger embedded asteroid-wall bay frames and pushed districts farther apart across a larger facility footprint.

runs.label: foreground asteroid cutaway frame pass
runs.notes: Added heavy foreground/side/upper asteroid cutaway framing so the fixed camera reads like looking into a carved facility.

runs.label: cutaway rock strata material pass
runs.notes: Added layered shadow shelves, mineral veins, and side fracture seams to make the asteroid cutaway read as carved rock instead of a flat frame.

runs.label: remote bay maintenance drone proxy asset pass
runs.notes: Added hand-blocked remote bay maintenance drone proxies with bay-accent optics, clamp arms, and repair spark animation to prove the contained asset pipeline in-scene.

runs.label: operator avatar kit proxy asset pass
runs.notes: Added hand-blocked operator suit kit details: shoulder yokes, chest plates, role stripes, backpack blocks, gauntlets, and boot stance bars so agents read as suited operators at facility distance.

runs.label: console chair kit proxy asset pass
runs.notes: Replaced primitive console/chair station blocks with hand-blocked kit details: plinths, black-glass terminal frames, support struts, tactile key strips, swivel bases, bucket seats, high backs, headrests, and wraparound monitor slabs.

runs.label: vertical slice asteroid container and lighting pass
runs.notes: Reprioritized outside-in work: added heavier vertical-slice asteroid masses, exposed cut planes, jagged borders, sediment seams, rear cavern darkness, and lowered ambient lighting with stronger rim/practical lights.

runs.label: wide vertical-slice camera pass
runs.notes: Pulled the fixed front-facing camera much farther back with a wider FOV/far plane so the asteroid cutaway container reads before interior details.

runs.label: untrapped wide overview and lighting fix
runs.notes: Pulled the camera much farther outside the vertical slice, widened FOV/fog range, centered the overview on the full footprint, and raised ambient/hemisphere/top/rim lighting so all station districts are visible.

runs.label: full cutaway overview framing pass
runs.notes: Pulled the default camera farther outside the asteroid slice, widened FOV/fog/far plane, and centered the overview target so the full cutaway container and four station districts fit before interior detail.

runs.label: macro outside-in reveal and container read pass
runs.notes: Macro outside-in pass: added wider asteroid shoulder/crown/sill masses for the pulled-back camera, nested rear cavern darkness/rim layers for depth, and district reveal lighting/glow planes so all four station bays read without flat wash.

runs.label: macro facility depth and scale marker pass
runs.notes: Added layered production terraces, vertical service shafts, diagonal braces, district-to-rear conduits, distant production-window scale markers, and a longer fog falloff so the pulled-back cutaway reads as a deep asteroid facility instead of a flat room.

runs.label: wide exterior aperture and rear void pass
runs.notes: Pulled the default composition farther outside the asteroid slice, added a wider exterior asteroid proscenium with cut-face survey marks, expanded rear production void layers, and rebuilt wide-overview readability lighting so the full container and four districts read at once.

runs.label: mine-mouth aperture and parallax depth pass
runs.notes: Raised the macro gate to 450 source lines and shipped a larger outside-in pass: pushed the default camera/fog farther out, added an irregular mine-mouth asteroid aperture with occlusion masks, expanded cut-plane datum layers, deepened rear/side production galleries, and added controlled rim/readability lighting for all four districts.

runs.label: overview legibility and production-horizon pass
runs.notes: Added a wide-overview legibility pass for the exterior cutaway: datum ribs around the asteroid shell, deep side cavern voids, rear horizon production scale markers, foreground parallax ledge shadows, district silhouette light wells, and atmospheric gradients so the larger aperture still keeps all four districts readable.

runs.label: north-star pressure gasket and command-read pass
runs.notes: Benchmarked against world-architecture and materials/avatar moodboards, then added engineered pressure-gasket shell framing, wide command hierarchy read lines, four district exterior read frames, cold exterior vista scale layers, tiny shell scale silhouettes, and cinematic shell contrast lighting. Local screenshot capture was blocked and recorded honestly in the visual review.

runs.label: exterior station network and lower cutaway pass
runs.notes: Benchmarked against world-architecture and materials/avatar moodboards, then added exterior station infrastructure, lower mechanical cutaway levels, segmented viewport blast shutters, docked craft silhouettes, massive hull load ribs, exterior network signal arcs, and a command-primary lighting hierarchy. Screenshot capture remained blocked and is documented in the visual review.

runs.label: habitation deck-ring shell strata pass
runs.notes: Benchmarked against the north-star moodboards, then added layered habitation deck rings, stepped observation gallery strata, quiet inset viewport slit bands, deck-ring lighting hierarchy, rock-to-hull compression layers, outer-aperture transit pods, and sparse wayfinding beacons to make the cutaway read as an inhabited pressure shell inside the asteroid. Screenshot capture remained blocked and is documented in the visual review.
